headline: Find the shop
intro: We're up Summit Ridge Road — above the village, past the point where your calves file a complaint. Look for the green awning and the smell of roast. We'll have something warm ready when you catch your breath.

directions.title: From the Trans-Canada
directions.text: Take the Lake Louise exit, then climb. And climb. Summit Ridge is 2.4 km of switchbacks that feel personally motivated. We're on the left after the gravel pull-off — white building, pine-green awning, oxygen optional.

directions.title: Parking
directions.text: A few spots out front, small lot behind if those are gone. Same rule as the lakeshore lot in July: show up after 8am and you're riding the Parks Canada shuttle with everyone else who also 'just wanted a quick walk around the lake.'

directions.title: When GPS fails
directions.text: It will. Call us from whichever hairpin just broke your spirit — half our first-timers do. We keep the kettle on.
